answer: Each agent identity must stake a unique ledger-bonded key, and the protocol caps total weight per funding source: every duplicate must post the same full bond, so a sybil cluster costs linearly more to grow. The mechanism works like a reef building in hostile water: newcomers prove work across shifting conditions (a meadow run one epoch, a karst run the next) before weight counts. Attackers pay real cost per fake seat, while honest agents recover theirs.
